verdict.rationale: Mercury docs explicitly state 'Issue scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions' (mercury-docs-20), backed by OAuth2 support (mercury-docs-15) with PKCE-required dynamic client registration and scoped access confirmed via probe (scopes_supported: read, offline_access) (mercury-probe-4), plus dashboard revocation ability (mercury-docs-25) and granular user permissions (mercury-docs-10). The MCP server itself is read-only by design (mercury-probe-5), reinforcing least-privilege for agent use cases. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of scoped API token issuance workflow in practice, and more detail on the granularity of scopes available beyond 'read'/'offline_access'.
